key_findings: Official Masang guide and Suba Episode3.2/4.6 pages confirm the circular gauge family, radar at upper right, and bottom quickslots.
The same Masang guide contains mismatched-era gauge illustrations; the small-SP diagram must not override a later screenshot or selected target version.
Masang trd4 confirms tc_inven is an embedded inventory panel in Item Trade Center; it is not evidence for the standalone inventory window.
The historical Suba PDF shows separate equipment/items panels beside an NPC shop.
No editorial official screenshot proving a standalone blue inventory window in client0.4.5.158/2025 was located within this bounded search.
